proof_body:
by
  intro a L hL h ε hε
  have hLp : 0 < |L| := abs_pos.2 hL
  obtain ⟨K1, h1⟩ := h (|L| / 2) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨K2, h2⟩ := h (ε * |L| * |L| / 2) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨max K1 K2, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have hn1 := h1 n (le_of_max_le_left hn)
  have hn2 := h2 n (le_of_max_le_right hn)
  have hlow : |L| / 2 < |a n| := by
    have h3 : |L| - |a n| ≤ |a n - L| := by
      rw [abs_sub_comm]
      exact abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub L (a n)
    linarith
  have hapos : 0 < |a n| := by linarith
  have hne : a n ≠ 0 := abs_pos.1 hapos
  refine ⟨hne, ?_⟩
  have heq : 1 / a n - 1 / L = (L - a n) / (a n * L) := by
    field_simp
  rw [heq, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_sub_comm, div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
  have h4 : ε * (|L| / 2 * |L|) ≤ ε * (|a n| * |L|) := by
    have h5 : |L| / 2 * |L| ≤ |a n| * |L| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlow.le hLp.le
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h5 hε.le
  have h6 : ε * (|L| / 2 * |L|) = ε * |L| * |L| / 2 := by ring
  linarith
